name: Securify
summary: Country blocker and fraud filter for Shopify: blocks countries, IP ranges, bots, VPNs and risky emails at checkout, and holds suspicious orders automatically.
best_for: stores seeing real fraud or bot traffic that want country, IP, VPN and email-risk rules plus automatic holds on suspicious orders, and who will review the block log rather than set and forget
skip_if: you are blocking on a hunch rather than on measured fraud: start by reading your order data, because a blocked legitimate customer never tells you they were blocked
honest_knock: Blocking by country and IP is a blunt instrument and it cuts both ways: every rule that keeps out a fraudster also keeps out a customer travelling, using a corporate VPN, or living behind a carrier NAT. The app is honest enough to give you a live log of what it blocked, and that log is the part to actually read: a rule set nobody reviews quietly costs sales. Also worth separating in your head: blocking bots from your analytics is a reporting fix, while blocking fraud at checkout is a money fix, and the two need different rules.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month, or $159 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/easy-block-customer-ip-country and in our own test that day; earlier: re-verified 2026-10-25 on apps.shopify.com/easy-block-customer-ip-country) Free plan plus two paid tiers. The listing changed after the reading of 20 October 2026: Pro rose from $5.99 to $19 a month, and the Advanced tier is gone. Free: unlimited country and IP blocking, 500 blocked visitors, up to 5 high-risk orders per 30 days, the last 1,000 visitor records and 7 days of analytics. Pro $19 a month or $159 a year (the card says save 30%): unlimited blocked visitors, up to 25 high-risk orders a month, the last 2,000 visitor records with export and 30 days of analytics. Growth $49 a month or $490 a year (save 17%): unlimited high-risk orders, AI-powered bot blocking, blocking risky emails at checkout and unlimited visitor logs. Both paid plans show a 7-day free trial. All charges are billed in USD every 30 days. Listed as 'Country Blocker Fraud Securify' from siimple.ai, with Shopify Flow actions and triggers. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing now prints a single Free plan card and no Pro or Growth card, with feature lines that read unlimited country and IP blocking, unlimited blocked visitors, unlimited high risk order alerts and unlimited visitor logs, and that name AI powered bot blocking and blocking of fake and risky emails; it shows 4.6 from 111 reviews. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the app started on its Free plan with no card and no account, and its Choose Your Plan screen listed Free, Pro at $19 a month or $159 a year and Growth at $49 a month or $490 a year, the amounts we recorded on 25 October 2026, with a 7 day trial on both paid plans. The in app Free plan was not unlimited: it allowed 500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders reviewed a month and the last 1,000 visitor logs with 7 days of analytics. VPN, proxy and datacenter blocking, an email check on every new order and a custom block page sat in Pro, and smart bot blocking and a customer risk scan in Growth. So the Free card on the listing promises more than the Free plan gave us inside the app. We did not start a paid trial.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Securify (IP and country blocker) on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan without a card or test charge, one click on Brazil that added a country rule at once (about 3 minutes after the install), the header App embed disabled and the pop-up saying that rules are not enforced until the theme app embed is on (the embed was not turned on, so the block page was not seen), the plan dialog with Free capped at 500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders a month and 1,000 visitor logs against the listing that shows unlimited, Pro at $19.00 a month or $159.00 a year and Growth at $49.00 a month or $490.00 a year, and the uninstall, which asks for a reason. Nothing was paid, approved or saved. Install: the app (listing apps.shopify.com/easy-block-customer-ip-country, developer siimple.ai, rating 4.6 from 111 reviews; App Store name Securify: IP & Country Blocker) was installed from its App Store listing through the install form in our own tab, and Install was clicked in the Shopify dialog at 22:47:38. No payment, account or tick box was asked. The app opened as Securify with the menu Block Countries, Block IPs, Block Emails and Order Protection, which matches the listing and the dossier (country, IP, bot and VPN blocking and a fraud filter). The first screen was a pop-up, Turn on the Securify app embed. Plan: the plan at install was Free; no card and no test charge came up. Order Protection showed Risky orders reviewed this month 0 of 5, Free plan, resets Dec 17. Core action: on Block Countries one click on Brazil on the world map made it red (User Blocked) and added the row Brazil, BR, Remove to the table Current Restrictions (1) at once, at about 22:51, about 3 minutes after the install and in 1 click. The header said App embed disabled and 0 / 500 blocked visitors, resets Dec 17. The app embed was not turned on because that would save a theme change, so the rule was made but the block page was not seen on the storefront; the effect of the rule was not tested. The pop-up says that until the embed is turned on visitors are not checked and country and VPN rules are not enforced. The rule was then removed (Current Restrictions (0)). Yellow Risk Flagged countries (United States, China, Japan, Sweden, Germany, France, Pakistan) are on the map by default. Plans: the dialog Choose Your Plan (Cancel anytime) shows Free $0 a month (Review 5 risky orders a month, Block unlimited countries & IPs, 500 blocked visitors a month, Last 1,000 visitor logs and 7 days of analytics), Pro $19.00 a month or $159.00 a year (Review 25 risky orders a month, Unlimited blocked visitors, VPN, proxy & datacenter blocking, Email check on every new order, Custom block page, 7-day free trial) and Growth $49.00 a month or $490.00 a year (Unlimited risky orders, Smart bot blocking, Customer risk scan for your whole list, 7-day free trial). Pro and Growth equal the dossier. Difference with the listing: the listing shows only Free, with Unlimited Blocked Visitors, Unlimited High-risk order alerts, AI-powered advanced bot blocking, Block fake and risky email and customers and Unlimited visitor logs. In the app the Free plan is capped at 500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders reviewed a month and the last 1,000 visitor logs; VPN and proxy blocking, the email check and bot blocking are in Pro and Growth. Checkout: the free plan stayed active and Start free trial was not clicked, so no Shopify approval screen, total, test charge or card field was seen. Nothing was approved. Cancelling: no paid plan was started. In Settings, Apps, Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Securify? with a required reason (Testing multiple apps was chosen); the app was uninstalled after the evidence was complete (message You've successfully uninstalled Securify). Not tested: turning on the app embed and seeing the block page, an IP rule, an email block, fraud alerts on real orders, VPN and bot blocking, the live visitor log and the paid plans. Clean up: the Brazil rule was removed, no theme change was saved, the app was uninstalled and our own tab was closed. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The rule only counts once the theme app embed is turned on, which the app shows in the header and in a pop-up; the embed was not turned on in this test, so the effect is not seen. The Free plan in the app is capped (500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders a month, 1,000 visitor logs) where the listing shows unlimited, and VPN, email check and bot blocking sit in Pro and Growth.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Securify (IP and country blocker) on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan without a card or test charge, one click on Brazil that added a country rule at once (about 3 minutes after the install), the header App embed disabled and the pop-up saying that rules are not enforced until the theme app embed is on (the embed was not turned on, so the block page was not seen), the plan dialog with Free capped at 500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders a month and 1,000 visitor logs against the listing that shows unlimited, Pro at $19.00 a month or $159.00 a year and Growth at $49.00 a month or $490.00 a year, and the uninstall, which asks for a reason. Nothing was paid, approved or saved. Install: the app (listing apps.shopify.com/easy-block-customer-ip-country, developer siimple.ai, rating 4.6 from 111 reviews; App Store name Securify: IP & Country Blocker) was installed from its App Store listing through the install form in our own tab, and Install was clicked in the Shopify dialog at 22:47:38. No payment, account or tick box was asked. The app opened as Securify with the menu Block Countries, Block IPs, Block Emails and Order Protection, which matches the listing and the dossier (country, IP, bot and VPN blocking and a fraud filter). The first screen was a pop-up, Turn on the Securify app embed. Plan: the plan at install was Free; no card and no test charge came up. Order Protection showed Risky orders reviewed this month 0 of 5, Free plan, resets Dec 17. Core action: on Block Countries one click on Brazil on the world map made it red (User Blocked) and added the row Brazil, BR, Remove to the table Current Restrictions (1) at once, at about 22:51, about 3 minutes after the install and in 1 click. The header said App embed disabled and 0 / 500 blocked visitors, resets Dec 17. The app embed was not turned on because that would save a theme change, so the rule was made but the block page was not seen on the storefront; the effect of the rule was not tested. The pop-up says that until the embed is turned on visitors are not checked and country and VPN rules are not enforced. The rule was then removed (Current Restrictions (0)). Yellow Risk Flagged countries (United States, China, Japan, Sweden, Germany, France, Pakistan) are on the map by default. Plans: the dialog Choose Your Plan (Cancel anytime) shows Free $0 a month (Review 5 risky orders a month, Block unlimited countries & IPs, 500 blocked visitors a month, Last 1,000 visitor logs and 7 days of analytics), Pro $19.00 a month or $159.00 a year (Review 25 risky orders a month, Unlimited blocked visitors, VPN, proxy & datacenter blocking, Email check on every new order, Custom block page, 7-day free trial) and Growth $49.00 a month or $490.00 a year (Unlimited risky orders, Smart bot blocking, Customer risk scan for your whole list, 7-day free trial). Pro and Growth equal the dossier. Difference with the listing: the listing shows only Free, with Unlimited Blocked Visitors, Unlimited High-risk order alerts, AI-powered advanced bot blocking, Block fake and risky email and customers and Unlimited visitor logs. In the app the Free plan is capped at 500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders reviewed a month and the last 1,000 visitor logs; VPN and proxy blocking, the email check and bot blocking are in Pro and Growth. Checkout: the free plan stayed active and Start free trial was not clicked, so no Shopify approval screen, total, test charge or card field was seen. Nothing was approved. Cancelling: no paid plan was started. In Settings, Apps, Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Securify? with a required reason (Testing multiple apps was chosen); the app was uninstalled after the evidence was complete (message You've successfully uninstalled Securify). Not tested: turning on the app embed and seeing the block page, an IP rule, an email block, fraud alerts on real orders, VPN and bot blocking, the live visitor log and the paid plans. Clean up: the Brazil rule was removed, no theme change was saved, the app was uninstalled and our own tab was closed. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The rule only counts once the theme app embed is turned on, which the app shows in the header and in a pop-up; the embed was not turned on in this test, so the effect is not seen. The Free plan in the app is capped (500 blocked visitors a month, 5 risky orders a month, 1,000 visitor logs) where the listing shows unlimited, and VPN, email check and bot blocking sit in Pro and Growth.
